'''Guyne''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who resided in the isolated village [[Torbel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Guyne was an elderly man, and in about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], in the aftermath of a [[theta storm]], Guyne and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] worked together to fix the village's damaged [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]].
